data.content: APPROVED plan review. The plan is complete, feasible, and keeps the trust boundary intact: provider evidence is sealed and authenticated; inbox objects are parsed by exact OID without checkout or execution; ccdc remains the sole generation constructor; immutable objects and archives precede exact control CAS; stale races rebuild from the winner; recovery is monotonic; and replay-equivalence plus live disposable canaries cover both providers. Failure paths preserve authoritative refs, SQLite state, and every retained object. Ownership is separated correctly from signing, enforcement, fetch/application, and bridge cutover. Implementation remains gated by knots-ccdc, knots-c472, knots-74e2, and knots-9b6a. No additional operator approval is required.
